capability: Compose protected session/library healing with quota-safe Research backfill, retained provider-PDF refusals, and truthful discovery health
source_of_truth: Git commit plus current release manifest
changes: Preserve the original recovery manifest as immutable provenance.
Persist producer authentication health in the existing MarketDesk SQLite meta table.
Expose AUTHENTICATED, AUTH_REQUIRED, or UNKNOWN through marketdesk status and the existing read-only feed probe.
Keep the research-feed watcher read-only; protected session healing remains inside the existing extractor profile and opens no second scheduler or health database.
Classify only proven pre-TLS Playwright disconnects as transient without replaying the failed request inline.
Requeue source-HTTP-5xx and typed pre-TLS failures as DISCOVERED, never permanently SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED.
Apply a five-minute per-account retry delay, preserving token-bucket pace and 70-downloads-per-rolling-24h ledger.
Retain session-expired parking after failed protected one-shot restore; preserve cap-bounce, dead-driver recycling, permanent non-PDF and privacy boundaries.
Bound optional wide-pass old-row heal attempts by the existing successful-heal quota, with a 60-second accumulated-call soft admission budget; an admitted call may overrun.
Preserve unopted manual/narrow discovery, comprehensive since/day/scanned coverage, mandatory new-report summaries and latest-feed merge.
Expose numeric optional-heal attempted/deferred/call-work counters in the existing discovery summary; preserve 300 successful heals, 5000 wide scanned rows and 70 downloads per rolling 24 hours.
Require a fresh raw session control before the protected one-shot terms-consent retry; reject still-malformed feed and metadata instead of accepting empty or partial success.
Reject non-list provision metadata, including null and later failed chunks, instead of returning empty or partial success.
Report browser construction or entry failures as UNKNOWN/BROWSER_START_FAILED in the existing health projection and dry-run plan; clear the flag after successful browser entry.
Release partial browser contexts and Playwright drivers after startup failures, preserving the original error and idempotent teardown.
Record typed discovery HEALTHY/FAILED/UNKNOWN in the incumbent SQLite meta table without a new queue, scheduler, publication path, or credential.
Use one shared per-plan and per-pull backfill admission function; clamp impossible raw demand reservations to a feasible cap share while reporting both raw and effective forecasts.
Require bounded per-account trailing-24h historical-download budget and recent healthy discovery evidence before backfill; default budget 0 preserves no-backfill production behavior.
Preserve provider cap, source-driven fresh-first candidate precedence, in-progress sole browser-profile owner, and the explicit Research Vault publication hold.
Refuse historical quota admission when the configured discovery freshness window is invalid/non-finite or when a discovery observation is more than five minutes in the future.
Treat invalid negative or NaN fresh-reserve ratios as a full-cap reservation rather than silently zeroing fresh protection.
Project incumbent SQLite discovery HEALTHY, FAILED or UNKNOWN through the bounded read-only feed probe together with independent producer authentication state.
Log an explicit MarketDesk discovery failure when browse or metadata is rejected despite a valid session, instead of misleading nothing-new health alone.

Keep the existing feed lock, watermark, single Chromium profile owner, download cap, and research-ingest workflow dispatch semantics unchanged; do not claim an hourly fallback can run during the known workflow hold.
When an existing research-ingest workflow dispatch is unavailable, preserve its watermark and report publication NOT confirmed instead of promising an hourly ingest that may be deliberately disabled.

Recognize only positively identified non-PDF binary containers as SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED; HTTP 401/403/404/429, successful-HTTP JSON failures, blank responses and ambiguous bytes preserve the paper for controlled future retry.

After one unqualified provider PDF response, retain its document in the existing retryable FAILED tier until daemon start/daily wide-pass reset; pause that account five minutes so one top-ranked rejection cannot starve other papers.
Manual download_pending also stops on provider rejection without invalidating the source row; confirmed binary non-PDF remains terminal and other papers continue.
Use actual America/New_York daylight-saving-aware hourly demand to preserve Eastern weekday/weekend fresh-report reserve through EST/EDT changes.
Refuse opt-in backfill when NEW_WINDOW_HOURS is shorter than the existing 24-hour download ledger; do not add a second tier/accounting store.
Propagate confirmed SessionExpired from the manual downloader instead of silently classifying lost authentication as an ordinary PDF provider refusal.
Correct the feed-watcher comment to disclose that a deliberately disabled research-ingest workflow cannot serve as the promised hourly backstop.
Preserve non-PDF terminal SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED only for positive binary signatures; all other upstream provider PDF failures remain retained and re-admitted through the original reset mechanism.
Where discovery, budget, or an unsafe fresh window refuses historical quota admission before any ledger read, display backfill_24h=unmeasured rather than inventing a zero spend measurement.
Make the existing research-feed watcher surface AUTH_REQUIRED without opening a second scheduler, health database, or automatic authentication path.
Keep existing session-expired, cap-bounce, dead-driver recycling, permanent non-PDF and privacy boundaries unchanged.
Classify malformed feed and browse arrays with one fresh raw session control; positive authentication preserves the existing discovery retry cadence without accepting the rejected response.
When browse/provision return {success:false} while latest/latest is an ID array, POST /terms/consent once and retry the rejected request.
Do not park the account for the authenticated T&Cs overlay; a dead session still raises SessionExpired with no consent POST.
Add marketdesk auth --force so a live latest feed cannot skip the headed login window.
On SessionExpired during discovery, attempt one silent Firebase IndexedDB restore through POST /api/user/login without storing a password.

Persist HEALTHY discovery and its actual new-report count after a successful protected silent-relogin discovery retry; failed restore or repeated session expiry retains FAILED health and parks the account.
non_goals: No queue, database schema table, bucket, scheduler, workflow, or publication-authority change.
No automatic immediate duplicate PDF request or download cap increase.
No new storage schema, durable retry scheduler, publisher, account credential or profile owner.
No automatic historical backfill admission; BACKFILL_BUDGET_PER_ACCOUNT_24H remains 0 unless separately configured on the account owner.
No MarketDesk browse/items entitlement workaround, recovery of report IDs, or re-enabling the held research-ingest workflow.
Does not repair upstream MarketDesk browse/item entitlement, discover new report metadata, override account access, or enable the held research-ingest workflow.
No password storage, new browser profile, or second LaunchAgent.
No LaunchAgent activation, restart, retirement, or replacement from this source packet.
Headed interactive login remains the human single-writer recovery when Firebase restore fails.
No entitlement/access bypass, immediate duplicate PDF request, download-quota increase, additional browser-profile owner, or PDF publication claim without served-byte proof.
This source composition performs no authentication, runtime activation, workflow re-enablement or held-operation replay.
